findings.summary: Corbel's zero-shot nDCG@10 average gain over Dovetail-DR (same bi-encoder with standard in-batch negatives) is 4.7 points (40.7 vs 36.0), which is slightly smaller than the 5.2-point gain previously reported for denoised hard-negative mining on a biomedical collection.
findings.scope: Average nDCG@10 across Brackwater-News, Felloe-Fin, Moorstone-Bio and Lintel-Law; single training run per system; no statistical tests reported.
findings.caveats: The prior 5.2-point gain was reported for a biomedical collection only, not the average across these four collections; no statistical significance tests were reported for either comparison.

findings.summary: Corbel outperforms Dovetail-DR on all four individual collections, with gains ranging from 2.9 points (Brackwater-News: 43.1 vs 38.4) to 5.9 points (Moorstone-Bio: 50.6 vs 44.7).
findings.scope: nDCG@10 per collection; single training run per system; no statistical tests reported.
findings.caveats: Gains are descriptive differences; no significance tests were reported.

findings.summary: Corbel also outperforms the lexical reference Lexi-Sparse on average (40.7 vs 35.3) and on all four collections, with the largest gain on Felloe-Fin (35.0 vs 27.9, +7.1 points).
findings.scope: nDCG@10 per collection and average; single training run per system; no statistical tests reported.
findings.caveats: Descriptive differences only; no significance tests reported.

sentences.text: Corbel's average zero-shot nDCG@10 gain over Dovetail-DR, the same bi-encoder trained with standard in-batch negatives, was 4.7 points (40.7 vs 36.0), slightly smaller than the 5.2-point improvement previously reported for denoised hard-negative mining on a biomedical collection.
Corbel outperformed Dovetail-DR on all four held-out collections, with per-collection gains ranging from 2.9 points on Brackwater-News (43.1 vs 38.4) to 5.9 points on Moorstone-Bio (50.6 vs 44.7).
Corbel also exceeded the lexical reference Lexi-Sparse on average (40.7 vs 35.3) and on every collection, with the largest margin on Felloe-Fin (35.0 vs 27.9, +7.1 points).
